cues.text: A twenty-seven-year-old man has a soft lump in his right scrotum.
There is a positive cough impulse, which suggests herniating bowel.
The doctor cannot get above the lump, so it arises from the inguinal canal.
The lump can be pushed back up along the inguinal canal.
With fingers over the deep inguinal ring, it does not reappear, even on coughing.
A hernia controlled by occluding the deep ring is pathognomonic of an indirect inguinal hernia.
